The Creation.posterAlt: Young plants grow along a rocky coast beside the sea in an imagined creation scene.
The Creation.description: Light spreads over dark water. Sky, land and plants appear, then the sun, moon and stars. Birds fly above the sea. Adam and Eve look around the garden before a final view of the quiet coast.

The Fall of Man.posterAlt: Eve reaches for fig-like fruit beside Adam and a serpent, with their bodies hidden by garden leaves.
The Fall of Man.description: Garden leaves conceal Adam and Eve beside a serpent and fig-like fruit. Close views show Eve eating, passing fruit to Adam, and Adam eating. Their eyes show concern. Later, wearing skin garments, they leave the garden.

Cain and Abel.posterAlt: One man carries grain while another holds a lamb beside a stone altar in an imagined scene.
Cain and Abel.description: Two men stand near a stone altar in a harvested field. One carries grain; the other holds a lamb. A curved tool lies among stalks. A man stands alone in wheat, then walks into dry land.

The Line of Seth.posterAlt: An older man, two younger adults and a child walk along a green hillside in an imagined scene.
The Line of Seth.description: An older man walks with two younger adults and a child through green fields. A lone figure crosses misty hills. Four men gather beside a stone house, where an elder rests his hand on a younger man.

Noah and the Flood.posterAlt: An older man stands before a wooden ark on dry ground, with a rainbow overhead in an imagined scene.
Noah and the Flood.description: An older man welcomes two adults into a wooden ark as animals gather outside. The ark floats on floodwater beneath dark clouds. Later, the man stands on dry ground beside the ark, and a rainbow appears overhead.

The Family of Noah.posterAlt: Two men carry a large cloth into a shaded tent. An imagined scene.
The Family of Noah.description: An older man gathers grapes with three younger men. Two men later carry a large cloth into a tent. The final scene shows groups walking toward settlements beside a river.

The Tower of Babel.posterAlt: People leave an unfinished brick wall and walk toward distant settlements. An imagined scene.
The Tower of Babel.description: Builders stand beside a tall mudbrick tower and struggle to understand each other. They leave the work behind and walk toward distant settlements.

The Call of Abram.posterAlt: An older traveler leads a household through rocky hills before dawn. An imagined scene.
The Call of Abram.description: A household travels through rocky hills before dawn. Later, an older man places stones together beneath trees.

Abram and Lot.posterAlt: Abram and Lot meet at night, with one resting a hand on the other's shoulder. An imagined scene.
Abram and Lot.description: An older man and a younger man look across a green valley. The younger man departs with his household and animals. Later, the two men meet again at night.

Hagar and Ishmael.posterAlt: A pregnant woman rests beside a spring in a rocky canyon. An imagined scene.
Hagar and Ishmael.description: A pregnant woman rests beside a spring in a shaded canyon. Later, she cradles a newborn outside a tent.

Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant.posterAlt: An older woman listens from her tent as a man serves three visitors. An imagined scene.
Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant.description: An older woman listens at a tent entrance. Behind her, a man serves food to three seated visitors. Her surprised expression becomes a smile.

Lot Leaves Sodom.posterAlt: An older man and two young women leave a burning city as another woman turns back. An imagined scene.
Lot Leaves Sodom.description: An older man and two young women climb a rocky path away from a burning city. Behind them, another woman pauses and turns back.

Isaac and Ishmael.posterAlt: A woman draws water beside a boy resting in the shade. An imagined scene.
Isaac and Ishmael.description: An older woman smiles with a young child. A woman and an older boy leave their camp. Later, the woman finds water and shares it with the boy.

The Binding of Isaac.posterAlt: An older man and a boy stand beside a stone altar and a ram. An imagined scene.
The Binding of Isaac.description: An older man and a boy carry supplies up a rocky path. They stand beside a stone altar. A ram appears in nearby thorn scrub.

Isaac and Rebekah.posterAlt: A traveler leads a line of camels away from a village at dusk. An imagined scene.
Isaac and Rebekah.description: A traveler leads camels from a village. A young woman gives water at a well. Later, she arrives with a camel and meets a man in a field.

Jacob and Esau.posterAlt: Two brothers share a bowl of stew beside a fire. An imagined scene.
Jacob and Esau.description: Two brothers exchange a bowl of stew. An older man blesses a younger man. A woman then gives the young man a bundle before he leaves.

Jacob’s Household.posterAlt: A father holds a child while his household works beside sheep. An imagined scene.
Jacob’s Household.description: A man meets a woman by a well. He later speaks with an older man and a woman. The final scene shows a growing household with children and sheep.

Jacob Returns to Canaan.posterAlt: Two brothers embrace beside a river as their households wait. An imagined scene.
Jacob Returns to Canaan.description: A caravan crosses open land. Two men struggle beside a river at night. Later, two brothers meet and embrace as their households wait nearby.

Dinah at Shechem.posterAlt: An older man talks with a seated man while two men stand nearby. An imagined scene.
Dinah at Shechem.description: Men meet in a courtyard. Two brothers stand together. A young woman leaves through a city gate, and an older man later addresses the brothers.

The Death of Rachel.posterAlt: A man mourns beside a standing stone as a woman holds a newborn. An imagined scene.
The Death of Rachel.description: A man rests his hand on a standing stone and bows his head. A woman holding a newborn and another man stand behind him at dusk.

Israel Oppressed in Egypt.posterAlt: Two workers shape mud bricks in the sun. An imagined scene.
Israel Oppressed in Egypt.description: A ruler speaks with men in a stone chamber. Workers shape mud bricks under the sun. Two women later speak together in a lamplit room.

Joseph and His Brothers.posterAlt: An older man holds a striped robe close to his face. An imagined scene.
Joseph and His Brothers.description: Joseph stands among sheep while his brothers watch. Bundles of grain fill a field. Later, he walks beside a man, and an older man holds a striped robe.

Joseph in Egypt.posterAlt: A man wearing an Egyptian collar watches workers carry baskets. An imagined scene.
Joseph in Egypt.description: Men speak inside a stone room. A young man then meets a ruler. Later, he wears an Egyptian collar and oversees people carrying baskets beside grain stores.

Judah and Tamar.posterAlt: A woman and an older man face each other across a table holding a staff and seal. An imagined scene.
Judah and Tamar.description: A woman waits at a doorway. A staff, cord and seal lie on a stone surface. Later, she presents these objects before an older man.

Moses Flees to Midian.posterAlt: A traveler shares a meal with an older man and a woman in a courtyard. An imagined scene.
Moses Flees to Midian.description: A man leaves a walled settlement and crosses dry ground. He meets women carrying water jars. Later, he shares food with an older man and a woman.

Moses Returns to Egypt.posterAlt: An older man holding a staff stands before elders who bow. An imagined scene.
Moses Returns to Egypt.description: An older man travels with a household and a donkey. He embraces another older man. Later, he addresses a group of elders, who bow.

Jacob Blesses His Family.posterAlt: An elderly Jacob wears a striped hood and looks down. An imagined scene.
Jacob Blesses His Family.description: A close portrait shows an elderly Jacob in a striped hood. He turns his gaze and lowers his head. His hands and sons are outside the frame.

Joseph Reunites His Family.posterAlt: Two men embrace in a stone hall. An imagined scene.
Joseph Reunites His Family.description: A man wearing an Egyptian collar places his hands on another man's shoulders. They embrace as other men watch nearby.

The Burning Bush.posterAlt: An older man holding a staff bows beside a burning bush. An imagined scene.
The Burning Bush.description: An older man stands beside a burning bush in rocky country. He lowers his head and bows while the branches remain visible within the flames.

Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh.posterAlt: Moses and Aaron face a seated Pharaoh in an imagined Egyptian columned hall.
Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh.description: Moses and Aaron appeal to Pharaoh in a columned hall. Pharaoh turns aside. Later, Moses watches workers press mud into brick molds.

The Plagues of Egypt.posterAlt: A farmer shields his face beneath a locust swarm beside canal farmland.
The Plagues of Egypt.description: A farmer shields his face as locusts sweep across fields beside an Egyptian canal. Dense darkness settles over a deserted mudbrick lane.

The Passover and the Death of the Firstb.posterAlt: A household shares flat bread around a low table in a lamplit room.
The Passover and the Death of the Firstb.description: A hand marks an ancient doorway beam. Inside, a household shares flatbread and food by lamplight, with the door closed and travel bundles ready.

The Exodus from Egypt.posterAlt: Moses walks with households and animals away from Egypt toward cloud.
The Exodus from Egypt.description: Moses leads households and animals away from Egypt toward a pillar of cloud. At night, the travelers move together across open wilderness toward a pillar of fire.

Crossing the Sea.posterAlt: Travelers cross dry ground between towering walls of water.
Crossing the Sea.description: Moses stands beside a path between walls of water. People and a loaded donkey cross on dry sand. Later, an elderly Miriam leads women with frame drums beside the sea.

Bitter Water, Manna and Quail.posterAlt: A family gathers white manna into woven baskets at dawn.
Bitter Water, Manna and Quail.description: Moses casts wood into bitter water. Quail settle beside a wilderness tent at evening. At dawn, a family gathers white manna into baskets.

Water from the Rock and the Battle with.posterAlt: Grey-haired Moses sits on a stone while Aaron in a striped mantle and another man support his outstretched arms from opposite sides.
Water from the Rock and the Battle with.description: Water flows from a rock as people fill jars. On a rocky hill, seated Moses holds his arms out while grey-haired Aaron and another man support his wrists and forearms from opposite sides.

Jethro Advises Moses.posterAlt: Jethro gestures with open hands while Moses listens beneath woven shade.
Jethro Advises Moses.description: Beneath a woven shade, Jethro gestures toward a waiting line while Moses listens. In the camp, elders hear visitors in smaller groups.

The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sin.posterAlt: An assembly waits below a dark cloud-covered mountain lit by lightning.
The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sin.description: The assembly waits below the boundary at a cloud-covered Sinai as lightning flashes over the summit. Moses approaches the thick cloud while the people remain behind.

The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai.posterAlt: Moses and a companion walk up a rocky mountain path toward cloud.
The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai.description: Hands hold an open covenant scroll before the assembly and stone altar. Later, Moses walks uphill toward cloud while a companion follows and pauses below.

The Birth and Rescue of Moses.posterAlt: An Egyptian woman opens a woven basket holding a wrapped infant among Nile reeds. An imagined scene.
The Birth and Rescue of Moses.description: A woman in linen kneels among reeds and opens a woven basket. A wrapped infant rests inside. An attendant leans closer as a girl watches nearby. Ripples move across the Nile.

The Golden Calf.posterAlt: Moses holds stone tablets as people gather around a golden calf in an imagined scene.
The Golden Calf.description: Moses stands before a golden calf while people celebrate behind him. He lowers the stone tablets and looks toward the gathering.

Moses Sees God's Glory.posterAlt: Moses shields his face in a rocky cleft as bright light passes outside. An imagined scene.
Moses Sees God's Glory.description: Moses shelters in a rocky cleft with his face shielded. Bright light passes outside, then fades as his cloak moves in the wind.

Building the Tabernacle.posterAlt: Craftspeople weave colored cloth and work on wooden frames beside the tabernacle. An imagined scene.
Building the Tabernacle.description: Craftspeople weave colored cloth and work on a wooden frame. The view moves toward the patterned curtains of the tabernacle.

Aaron and His Sons Are Ordained.posterAlt: Moses pours oil over Aaron's turban while two sons stand nearby. An imagined scene.
Aaron and His Sons Are Ordained.description: Moses pours oil over Aaron's head at the sanctuary entrance. Aaron bows his head as two sons stand nearby.

Nadab and Abihu.posterAlt: Two priests hold smoking incense pans near the sanctuary entrance. An imagined scene.
Nadab and Abihu.description: Two priests lift smoking incense pans at the sanctuary entrance. The view changes to fallen pans and glowing embers on the ground.

The Blasphemer Stoned.posterAlt: A man faces Moses and elders among the tents of the camp. An imagined scene.
The Blasphemer Stoned.description: A man stands before Moses and elders in the camp. Two men approach and guide him away while the others watch.

Counting the Camp.posterAlt: Hands arrange small stones into counted groups on a stone surface. An imagined scene.
Counting the Camp.description: Moses and Aaron stand beside camp elders who count small stones. Close views show hands sorting the stones into groups. The elders continue their work beside the tents.

Offerings and the Passover at Sinai.posterAlt: Three men carry offerings toward the tabernacle courtyard. An imagined scene.
Offerings and the Passover at Sinai.description: Three men walk toward a courtyard hung with blue and red cloth. One carries a metal bowl and another holds a woven basket. The entrance curtains move gently as they approach.

Leaving Sinai and the Complaints.posterAlt: Moses listens to elders beside resting families in a rocky camp. An imagined scene.
Leaving Sinai and the Complaints.description: Elders gather around Moses in a rocky camp. He listens with his staff in hand while families rest nearby. Small birds cross the cloudy sky as the camera moves closer.

Miriam and Aaron Speak Against Moses.posterAlt: A hooded woman faces Moses and Aaron outside a large tent. An imagined scene.
Miriam and Aaron Speak Against Moses.description: A woman seen from behind gestures toward Moses and Aaron outside a tent. Moses holds his staff and listens. Aaron turns toward him as the camera moves closer.

The Twelve Spies.posterAlt: Two scouts carry a heavy grape cluster on a wooden pole through a vineyard. An imagined scene.
The Twelve Spies.description: Two scouts carry a large cluster of grapes between them on a wooden pole. Other travelers walk ahead along the vineyard path. The fruit sways gently as the carriers move.

Water from the Rock at Meribah.posterAlt: People fill clay jars beneath water flowing from a rock beside Moses and Aaron. An imagined scene.
Water from the Rock at Meribah.description: Water flows from a rock into a shallow pool. People kneel to fill clay jars while Moses and Aaron watch. The camera moves closer to Moses holding his staff.

The Bronze Serpent.posterAlt: A bronze snake is fixed near the top of a wooden pole against a blue evening sky. An imagined scene.
The Bronze Serpent.description: Moses holds a tall pole beside people gathered at dusk. The camera moves upward to a bronze snake fixed near the top.

Korah's Rebellion.posterAlt: Elderly hands lift a wooden rod bearing almond blossoms and green fruit. An imagined scene.
Korah's Rebellion.description: Hands lift a wooden rod from a table. White flowers and green almonds grow along its branches. The hands turn the rod in the light.

Edom Refuses Passage and Aaron Dies.posterAlt: Elderly hands settle a blue robe with gold edging over a man's linen tunic. An imagined scene.
Edom Refuses Passage and Aaron Dies.description: Hands place a blue robe over a man's linen tunic. The cloth settles across his shoulders. Rocky hills rise behind him in the evening light.

Victories over Sihon and Og.posterAlt: A stone well holds rippling water beside an upright clay jar. An imagined scene.
Victories over Sihon and Og.description: Water ripples inside a stone well. The camera rises toward a clay jar and green hills beyond. This illustrates the well scene within the longer journey and battle account.

Balaam and Balak.posterAlt: Balaam sits on a gray donkey before a messenger in a vineyard lane. An imagined scene.
Balaam and Balak.description: A donkey slows in a narrow stone lane. Balaam turns toward a messenger holding a lowered sword. This illustrates one encounter within the longer Balaam and Balak account.

Baal of Peor.posterAlt: Two adults pass a fruit bowl near lamps and a carved stone at night. An imagined scene.
Baal of Peor.description: Two adults pass a bowl of fruit across a low table. An older observer stands apart near tents and lamps. This depicts the communal meal, with later violence and the plague omitted.

A New Census and Joshua Appointed.posterAlt: Five sisters present their inheritance claim before Moses and Eleazar. An imagined scene.
A New Census and Joshua Appointed.description: Five sisters stand before Moses and Eleazar. One opens her hands as the elders listen. This illustrates the inheritance petition within the census and succession account.

Vengeance on Midian.posterAlt: An officer places a gold ornament in a bowl before Moses and Eleazar. An imagined scene.
Vengeance on Midian.description: An officer places a gold ornament in a metal bowl. Moses and Eleazar look down as the officers stand nearby. The clip depicts the offering, with the campaign and killings omitted.

Tribes Settle East of the Jordan.posterAlt: Moses meets two tribal leaders beside grazing sheep and a stone wall. An imagined scene.
Tribes Settle East of the Jordan.description: Two leaders meet Moses beside grazing sheep. A worker carries stone behind a low wall, with the Jordan valley beyond. This illustrates the settlement agreement.

Moses Recalls the Wilderness Years.posterAlt: Seated Moses gestures toward distant hills as families listen. An imagined scene.
Moses Recalls the Wilderness Years.description: Moses sits among families and elders beside a tree. He gestures toward the hills as the camera pulls back. This illustrates his recollection without showing the earlier battles.

Moses Sets Apart Three Cities of Refuge.posterAlt: An anonymous traveler approaches elders at an open stone gateway. An imagined scene.
Moses Sets Apart Three Cities of Refuge.description: A traveler approaches elders at a stone gateway. An elder opens his hand to receive him. This illustrates refuge generally; the passage names cities without describing this individual event.

Moses Recalls the Golden Calf.posterAlt: Elderly Moses sits beneath a woven canopy with attentive listeners. An imagined scene.
Moses Recalls the Golden Calf.description: Moses lowers his open hands while listeners watch beneath a canopy. The scene illustrates his later recollection in Moab. It does not depict a second golden calf incident.

Moses Recalls the Second Tablets.posterAlt: Moses lowers two stone tablets into a plain wooden chest. An imagined scene.
Moses Recalls the Second Tablets.description: Moses lowers two stone tablets into a plain wooden chest. A closer view shows them resting inside. This illustrates the tablets' placement within the longer recollection.

Joshua Commissioned and the Law Entruste.posterAlt: Moses gives a scroll to a priest while Joshua stands nearby. An imagined scene.
Joshua Commissioned and the Law Entruste.description: Moses releases a rolled scroll into a priest’s hands while Joshua watches. This illustrates the law’s entrusting within the longer succession account.

The Death of Moses.posterAlt: Moses looks across the Jordan valley from a rocky height. An imagined scene.
The Death of Moses.description: Moses stands on a rocky height, his mantle moving in the wind. The view moves toward the valley. The clip illustrates his final view of the land, without depicting his death or burial.

Joshua Commissioned.posterAlt: Joshua stands before leaders above the Jordan valley. An imagined scene.
Joshua Commissioned.description: Joshua gestures toward the Jordan valley, then lowers his hand as leaders watch. This illustrates his leadership after Moses’s death.

Rahab and the Spies.posterAlt: Rahab secures a scarlet cord while two spies wait nearby. An imagined scene.
Rahab and the Spies.description: Rahab secures the scarlet cord at her window, then turns toward the two waiting spies. The clip illustrates their agreement without depicting the escape.

Crossing the Jordan.posterAlt: Priests stand with a covered chest as families cross the dry riverbed. An imagined scene.
Crossing the Jordan.description: Priests stand with the covered chest in the dry riverbed while families walk past. This illustrates the crossing, without showing the stopping or return of the water.

Circumcision and Passover at Gilgal.posterAlt: A family shares flatbread beside tents at Gilgal. An imagined scene.
Circumcision and Passover at Gilgal.description: A father breaks flatbread and offers it to a child as the mother watches. This depicts the Passover meal at Gilgal; the other events are not shown.

The Fall of Jericho.posterAlt: Joshua and horn-bearing priests stand before falling walls. An imagined scene.
The Fall of Jericho.description: Priests sound horns as part of Jericho’s wall collapses in dust. Joshua watches in the foreground. The later killings and rescue of Rahab are not depicted.

Achan's Sin and Ai.posterAlt: Joshua holds an open scroll beside a stone altar. An imagined scene.
Achan's Sin and Ai.description: Joshua looks down at a law scroll, then toward the gathered listeners. This depicts the law reading after Ai, with Achan’s punishment and the fighting omitted.

The Gibeonite Deception.posterAlt: Travelers present worn supplies as Joshua inspects them. An imagined scene.
The Gibeonite Deception.description: A traveler sets down a worn waterskin and bread. Joshua leans forward to inspect the supplies. The clip illustrates the deception rather than a treaty signing.

The Sun Stands Still.posterAlt: Joshua raises an arm beneath the sun and moon above a valley. An imagined scene.
The Sun Stands Still.description: Joshua holds up his arm beneath the sun and visible moon, then lowers it. This illustrates his appeal; the battle and prolonged daylight are not shown.

Northern Campaign and the Land Taken.posterAlt: Joshua surveys the green northern hills beside his companions. An imagined scene.
Northern Campaign and the Land Taken.description: Joshua surveys the northern hills as the camera moves across the landscape. This illustrates the campaign setting without showing the battles.

Caleb Receives Hebron.posterAlt: Caleb stands with Joshua and relatives above the hills near Hebron. An imagined scene.
Caleb Receives Hebron.description: Caleb lowers his hand after pointing toward Hebron, while Joshua and relatives listen. The clip illustrates his request, without showing the later conquest.

The Altar by the Jordan.posterAlt: Phinehas and tribal representatives stand beside the Jordan altar. An imagined scene.
The Altar by the Jordan.description: The delegation discusses the stone altar beside the Jordan. The clip illustrates their exchange, without showing a sacrifice or the threatened war.

Joshua's Farewell and Covenant at Sheche.posterAlt: An elderly Joshua touches the witness stone beneath an oak. An imagined scene.
Joshua's Farewell and Covenant at Sheche.description: Joshua lowers his hand onto the witness stone as the people listen beneath the oak. This illustrates the covenant gathering near the end of his life.

Incomplete Conquest.posterAlt: A messenger stands before mourning families outside a hill town. An imagined scene.
Incomplete Conquest.description: A messenger lowers his hands as the families listen and bow their heads. This illustrates the warning at Bochim, without showing the conquests.

The Cycle of the Judges.posterAlt: Older and younger family members sit in a lamp-lit courtyard. An imagined scene.
The Cycle of the Judges.description: An older woman gestures as younger family members look toward a nearby shrine. This illustrates the passage’s generational theme rather than every cycle described.

Othniel, Ehud and Shamgar.posterAlt: Ehud lowers a ram’s horn while people gather below the ridge. An imagined scene.
Othniel, Ehud and Shamgar.description: Ehud finishes a horn call and lowers the horn as people gather. This depicts Judges 3:27, rather than the accounts of all three judges.

Deborah and Barak.posterAlt: Deborah sits beneath a palm facing Barak and listeners. An imagined scene.
Deborah and Barak.description: Deborah lowers her hand and Barak nods as the others listen. The clip illustrates their meeting, without showing the battle or Sisera’s death.

Gideon and the Midianites.posterAlt: Gideon holds a torch in his left hand and a horn in his right. An imagined scene.
Gideon and the Midianites.description: Gideon watches the camp while his torch flickers. This illustrates the night signal setting without showing fighting or the later events.

Abimelech.posterAlt: Jotham stands on a rocky ledge above the listeners and Shechem. An imagined scene.
Abimelech.description: Jotham lowers his hand after gesturing toward Shechem. This illustrates his warning within the Abimelech story, without depicting the killings.

Jephthah's Vow.posterAlt: Jephthah and his daughter face each other outside the house. An imagined scene.
Jephthah's Vow.description: Jephthah bows his head as his daughter stops smiling. This illustrates his return in Judges 11:34-35 without showing harm.

Samson.posterAlt: Samson carries the wooden gates up a rocky slope. An imagined scene.
Samson.description: Samson takes slow steps uphill carrying the gate leaves, posts and bar. This illustrates Judges 16:3, rather than his whole life.

Micah's Idols and the Danites.posterAlt: Micah and a Levite stand beside a household shrine. An imagined scene.
Micah's Idols and the Danites.description: Micah lowers his hand while the Levite listens and nods. This illustrates their arrangement in Judges 17, rather than the later Danite journey.

The Levite and Gibeah.posterAlt: An elderly host welcomes travelers and their donkey at dusk. An imagined scene.
The Levite and Gibeah.description: The host invites the travelers toward his doorway. This illustrates the arrival in Judges 19:16-21, without depicting the later violence.

Naomi and Ruth Return to Bethlehem.posterAlt: Ruth supports Naomi on a path above Bethlehem. An imagined scene.
Naomi and Ruth Return to Bethlehem.description: Ruth and Naomi walk together toward Bethlehem. This illustrates their arrival, rather than every event in Ruth 1.

Ruth Gleans in Boaz's Field.posterAlt: Ruth gathers fallen barley as Boaz watches in the field. An imagined scene.
Ruth Gleans in Boaz's Field.description: Ruth adds fallen barley to her bundle while Boaz lowers his hand. This illustrates her gleaning in Ruth 2.

The Threshing Floor.posterAlt: Ruth and Boaz face each other beside grain at night. An imagined scene.
The Threshing Floor.description: Ruth lifts her gaze while Boaz listens at the threshing floor. This illustrates their conversation, rather than every action in Ruth 3.

Boaz Redeems and Marries Ruth.posterAlt: Boaz looks toward gate witnesses beside a sandal transaction. An imagined scene.
Boaz Redeems and Marries Ruth.description: Boaz turns toward the elders while the kinsman holds a sandal. This illustrates the gate meeting, rather than the marriage itself.

Hannah and the Birth of Samuel.posterAlt: Hannah presents young Samuel to elderly Eli. An imagined scene.
Hannah and the Birth of Samuel.description: Hannah holds Samuel’s shoulders as Eli welcomes him. This illustrates the dedication in 1 Samuel 1, rather than Samuel’s birth.

Eli's Sons and Samuel's Call.posterAlt: Young Samuel listens beside an oil lamp while Eli rests. An imagined scene.
Eli's Sons and Samuel's Call.description: Samuel turns toward the doorway as if listening, while Eli rests behind him. This illustrates Samuel’s call, rather than the conduct of Eli’s sons.

The Ark Captured and Returned.posterAlt: Two cows pull a cart carrying the ark into a wheat field. An imagined scene.
The Ark Captured and Returned.description: Two cows draw the ark toward wheat harvesters. This illustrates its return in 1 Samuel 6:13-14, rather than its capture or every later event.

Samuel Judges Israel.posterAlt: Elder Samuel lowers his hand beside a memorial stone. An imagined scene.
Samuel Judges Israel.description: Samuel lowers his hand toward the memorial stone as the people listen. This illustrates Ebenezer in 1 Samuel 7:12, rather than the battle.

Israel Demands a King.posterAlt: Elders appeal to Samuel in a shaded courtyard. An imagined scene.
Israel Demands a King.description: An elder lowers his open hands while Samuel listens. This illustrates the request for a king in 1 Samuel 8:4-6, rather than Saul’s coronation.

Saul Rejected.posterAlt: Saul holds Samuel’s torn mantle as Samuel turns away. An imagined scene.
Saul Rejected.description: Samuel turns away while Saul looks at the torn hem he holds. This illustrates 1 Samuel 15:27-29, rather than the full account of Saul’s rejection.

David Anointed.posterAlt: Samuel pours oil onto young David’s hair. An imagined scene.
David Anointed.description: Samuel pours oil onto David’s curls as the family watches. This illustrates the anointing in 1 Samuel 16:12-13, rather than David’s later service to Saul.

David and Goliath.posterAlt: The adult Philistine champion waits above the valley of Elah. An imagined scene.
David and Goliath.description: Goliath waits on a rocky ridge as banners move in the wind. This selective scene illustrates the challenge in 1 Samuel 17:4-10; David and the fight are not shown.

Saul's Jealousy and David's Flight.posterAlt: Jonathan gives a folded blue robe to young David. An imagined scene.
Saul's Jealousy and David's Flight.description: Jonathan lets go of the robe as David receives it. This illustrates their covenant in 1 Samuel 18:3-4, rather than Saul’s attacks or David’s flight.

David in the Wilderness.posterAlt: Abigail appeals to adult David beside baskets of provisions. An imagined scene.
David in the Wilderness.description: Abigail lowers her hands while David listens beside the provisions. This illustrates their conversation in 1 Samuel 25, rather than every event during David’s flight.

Saul and the Medium at Endor; Saul's Dea.posterAlt: Disguised Saul listens to the older woman at Endor. An imagined scene.
Saul and the Medium at Endor; Saul's Dea.description: The woman lowers her hand as Saul listens beside an oil lamp. This illustrates the consultation in 1 Samuel 28, without an apparition or Saul’s later death.

David Becomes King.posterAlt: An elder pours oil onto David’s head at Hebron. An imagined scene.
David Becomes King.description: David bows while an elder anoints him at Hebron. This illustrates his accession in 2 Samuel 5:3-4, rather than the preceding civil conflict.

Jerusalem and the Ark.posterAlt: David celebrates before the ark as its bearers enter Jerusalem. An imagined scene.
Jerusalem and the Ark.description: David takes a joyful step before the covered ark and its bearers. This illustrates the procession in 2 Samuel 6:12-15, not the capture of Jerusalem or the whole passage.

The Davidic Covenant.posterAlt: Nathan speaks with David in a shaded courtyard. An imagined scene.
The Davidic Covenant.description: Nathan lowers his hand while David listens. This illustrates the promise in 2 Samuel 7:4-17, not a divine apparition or every part of the covenant.

David and Mephibosheth.posterAlt: David welcomes seated Mephibosheth to his table. An imagined scene.
David and Mephibosheth.description: David welcomes Mephibosheth, who remains seated beside his crutches. This illustrates 2 Samuel 9:7-13, not the wars in the surrounding chapters.

David, Bathsheba and Uriah.posterAlt: Nathan confronts David, who bows his head. An imagined scene.
David, Bathsheba and Uriah.description: Nathan lowers his hand while David bows his head. This illustrates the confrontation in 2 Samuel 12:1-13; Bathsheba, Uriah and the child are not shown.

Amnon, Tamar and Absalom.posterAlt: Tamar sits wrapped in her shawl beside Absalom. An imagined scene.
Amnon, Tamar and Absalom.description: Tamar sits quietly while Absalom lowers his hand beside her shawl. This depicts shelter in his household in 2 Samuel 13:20; the assault and later violence are not shown.

Absalom's Rebellion.posterAlt: Barefoot David and his covered companions leave Jerusalem. An imagined scene.
Absalom's Rebellion.description: David and his companions walk uphill with covered heads. This illustrates the departure in 2 Samuel 15:30, not Absalom’s actions or the battle.

Sheba's Revolt and the Gibeonites.posterAlt: The wise woman speaks to Joab from Abel’s wall. An imagined scene.
Sheba's Revolt and the Gibeonites.description: The wise woman of Abel appeals to Joab from the wall. This illustrates 2 Samuel 20:16-22; the execution and later Gibeonite account are not shown.

The Exploits of David's Mighty Men.posterAlt: David pours water onto the ground before three companions. An imagined scene.
The Exploits of David's Mighty Men.description: David pours out the water rather than drinking it. This illustrates 2 Samuel 23:15-17; the earlier exploits and fighting are not shown.

The Census and the Plague.posterAlt: David gives Araunah payment at the threshing floor. An imagined scene.
The Census and the Plague.description: David gives Araunah a payment pouch beside the oxen. This illustrates the purchase in 2 Samuel 24:20-24; the census, plague and sacrifice are not shown.

Solomon Becomes King.posterAlt: Zadok anoints Solomon at Gihon as Nathan watches. An imagined scene.
Solomon Becomes King.description: Zadok pours oil onto Solomon’s curls, then lowers the horn. This illustrates the anointing in 1 Kings 1:32-40; the later succession events are not shown.

Solomon's Wisdom.posterAlt: Solomon listens to two women, one holding an infant. An imagined scene.
Solomon's Wisdom.description: Solomon listens to two women and lowers his hand. This selects the dispute in 1 Kings 3:16-28, not the threatened division of the child.

The Temple Built.posterAlt: Solomon watches workers place prepared stones at the Temple. An imagined scene.
The Temple Built.description: Solomon observes workers moving a prepared stone into place. This illustrates Temple construction, not the dedication or the full building process.

The Queen of Sheba and Solomon's Decline.posterAlt: The Queen of Sheba speaks with Solomon beside gifts. An imagined scene.
The Queen of Sheba and Solomon's Decline.description: The Queen of Sheba speaks while Solomon listens beside gifts. This selects the visit in 1 Kings 10:1-13, not Solomon's later decline.

The Kingdom Divides.posterAlt: Rehoboam listens to elders in an open courtyard. An imagined scene.
The Kingdom Divides.description: An elder addresses Rehoboam as others listen. This selects the consultation in 1 Kings 12:6-7, before the kingdom divides.

The Man of God from Judah.posterAlt: A prophet from Judah confronts Jeroboam beside an altar. An imagined scene.
The Man of God from Judah.description: A prophet from Judah addresses Jeroboam beside the altar. This selects their confrontation in 1 Kings 13:1-5, without the later journey or death.

Zimri's Coup and Omri's Rise.posterAlt: Omri surveys a hilltop building site with workers. An imagined scene.
Zimri's Coup and Omri's Rise.description: Omri points across the hill while workers build. This selects the founding of Samaria in 1 Kings 16:24, not Zimri's coup or death.

Elijah and the Drought.posterAlt: Ravens bring food beside Elijah and a flowing brook. An imagined scene.
Elijah and the Drought.description: Ravens bring food while Elijah sits beside the brook. This selects 1 Kings 17:2-6, not the later scenes with the widow.

Elijah on Mount Carmel.posterAlt: Elijah prays beside a burning altar on Mount Carmel. An imagined scene.
Elijah on Mount Carmel.description: Elijah raises his hands beside the burning altar. This selects the prayer and fire in 1 Kings 18:36-39, without the later killing.

Elijah at Horeb.posterAlt: Elijah holds his rough mantle at the cave entrance in dawn light. An imagined scene.
Elijah at Horeb.description: Elijah lowers his mantle and lifts his gaze at the cave entrance. This selective illustration concerns 1 Kings 19:11-13, not a visible portrayal of God or the call of Elisha.

Naboth's Vineyard.posterAlt: Elijah confronts Ahab among the grapevines. An imagined scene.
Naboth's Vineyard.description: Elijah lowers his hand while Ahab looks down in the vineyard. This illustrates the confrontation in 1 Kings 21:17-20; Naboth, Jezebel and the killing are not shown.

Ahab and Micaiah.posterAlt: Micaiah addresses two seated kings at a city gate. An imagined scene.
Ahab and Micaiah.description: Micaiah lowers his hand while Ahab and Jehoshaphat listen. This selects the council in 1 Kings 22:9-18, not the later battle.

Elijah Taken Up.posterAlt: Elisha watches a distant figure rise within a luminous whirlwind. An imagined scene.
Elijah Taken Up.description: Elisha watches the whirlwind beside the Jordan while holding a mantle. This selects Elijah’s departure in 2 Kings 2:11-13.

Elisha and Moab.posterAlt: Elisha stands beside trenches where men gather water. An imagined scene.
Elisha and Moab.description: Water fills the camp’s trenches as Elisha gestures and men gather it. This selects the provision of water in 2 Kings 3:16-20.

The Widow's Oil and the Shunammite's Son.posterAlt: A widow pours oil into a jar while her two sons help. An imagined scene.
The Widow's Oil and the Shunammite's Son.description: The widow pours oil while her sons move the jars, with the door shut. This selects 2 Kings 4:3-6, not the separate Shunammite family.

Naaman Healed.posterAlt: Naaman looks at his hands while standing in the Jordan. An imagined scene.
Naaman Healed.description: Naaman lowers his hands after washing while servants wait on the bank. This selects his healed moment in 2 Kings 5:14.

Elisha and the Arameans.posterAlt: A man reaches toward a floating axe head as Elisha points. An imagined scene.
Elisha and the Arameans.description: A man reaches toward the borrowed iron axe head floating in the river. This selects 2 Kings 6:5-7 rather than the later Aramean siege.

Jehu's Revolt.posterAlt: A messenger pours oil onto Jehu’s head in a closed room. An imagined scene.
Jehu's Revolt.description: The messenger anoints seated Jehu behind a shut door. This selects 2 Kings 9:2-6, not the later revolt or violence.

Athaliah and Joash.posterAlt: Jehoiada settles a circlet on young Joash’s head. An imagined scene.
Athaliah and Joash.description: Jehoiada crowns seven-year-old Joash of Judah while witnesses watch. This selects 2 Kings 11:12,21, not Athaliah’s death or later repairs.

Elisha's Death and Israel's Victories.posterAlt: Elderly Elisha guides a king holding a bow toward a window. An imagined scene.
Elisha's Death and Israel's Victories.description: Elderly Elisha rests his hands on Jehoash of Israel’s hands before the arrow is shot. This selects the counsel in 2 Kings 13:14-17.

The Fall of Samaria.posterAlt: Families carry belongings out through Samaria’s gate. An imagined scene.
The Fall of Samaria.description: Families walk slowly out through Samaria’s gate after its capture. This selects displacement in 2 Kings 17:5-6, not a complete siege reconstruction.

Hezekiah and Sennacherib.posterAlt: Hezekiah prays over a letter before the sanctuary. An imagined scene.
Hezekiah and Sennacherib.description: Hezekiah lifts his head in prayer over the letter. This selects 2 Kings 19:14-19, not the full siege.

Hezekiah's Illness and the Babylonian En.posterAlt: Hezekiah and Isaiah look at shadows on stone steps. An imagined scene.
Hezekiah's Illness and the Babylonian En.description: Isaiah gestures toward the steps as Hezekiah watches. This selects the sign scene in 2 Kings 20:8-11, not the envoys.

Manasseh, Amon and Josiah.posterAlt: An open law scroll rests in a chest amid temple repairs. An imagined scene.
Manasseh, Amon and Josiah.description: Light and dust cross an open scroll found during temple repairs. This selects 2 Kings 22:8-11, not all three kings' reigns.

The Fall of Jerusalem.posterAlt: Families carry belongings away from Jerusalem. An imagined scene.
The Fall of Jerusalem.description: A family walks away from Jerusalem after its fall. This selects displacement in 2 Kings 25:8-12, without depicting violence.

The Death of Saul.posterAlt: An oak shades low burial stones at dawn. An imagined scene.
The Death of Saul.description: Leaves and grass move above low burial stones. This recalls the burial beneath an oak in 1 Chronicles 10:12, without showing bodies.

David Takes Jerusalem and Gathers His Wa.posterAlt: David sits with companions at Jerusalem. An imagined scene.
David Takes Jerusalem and Gathers His Wa.description: David listens as a companion gestures in Jerusalem. This selects the gathering in 1 Chronicles 11:1-10, not every warrior's exploits.

The Ark Brought to Jerusalem.posterAlt: David rejoices beside the shoulder-borne ark procession. An imagined scene.
The Ark Brought to Jerusalem.description: Bearers carry the ark while David rejoices. This selects the successful procession in 1 Chronicles 15:15-28, not the earlier cart journey.

God's Covenant with David and His Wars.posterAlt: Nathan gestures as David listens in a courtyard. An imagined scene.
God's Covenant with David and His Wars.description: Nathan speaks with David about building a house. This selects their initial conversation in 1 Chronicles 17:1-4, not the later wars.

The Census and the Temple Site.posterAlt: Grain baskets and a sledge rest on a threshing floor. An imagined scene.
The Census and the Temple Site.description: Clouds pass over the threshing floor associated with the temple site. This illustrates 1 Chronicles 21:20-23 and 22:1, not the census itself.

David's Last Charge and Death.posterAlt: Elderly David and Solomon hold rolled plans. An imagined scene.
David's Last Charge and Death.description: David gives the plans to Solomon. This selects 1 Chronicles 28:11-12 rather than David's death or the completed temple.
